units.source_text: 且说源氏公子贺罢退朝，回到左大臣邸中，

en.t: After Prince Genji finished the ceremonial congratulations and withdrew from court, he returned to the residence of the Minister of the Left,

units.source_text: 但见葵姬照例端庄冷静，毫无一点亲昵的样子。

en.t: only to find Lady Aoi as dignified and composed as ever, showing not the slightest sign of affection.

units.source_text: 他觉得苦闷，便对她言道：“岁历更新了。

en.t: Distressed by this, he said to her, "The year has turned anew.

units.source_text: 你若得改变心情，稍稍随俗些，我何等欣幸！”

en.t: If only you would change your feelings and follow custom a little more, how happy I would be!"

units.source_text: 葵姬自从闻得公子特地迎进一个女子来加以宠爱的消息之后，

en.t: Ever since Lady Aoi had heard that the prince had deliberately brought another woman into his household and was favoring her,

units.source_text: 料想此人定受重视，将来可能扶正，心中便有了隔阂，

en.t: she had assumed that this woman must be held in high regard and might one day be raised to formal status, and a barrier had formed in her heart,

units.source_text: 因此对公子比前更加疏远冷淡了。

en.t: so she became even more distant and cold toward the prince than before.

units.source_text: 然而她勉强装作不知，对于源氏公子的随意不拘的态度，

en.t: Yet she forced herself to pretend she knew nothing, and toward Genji's casual, unconstrained manner,

units.source_text: 虽然不能热心应付，但也有适当的酬答，

en.t: although she could not respond warmly, she still gave him suitable replies,

units.source_text: 这涵养功夫毕竟是与众不同的。

en.t: and this self-command was, after all, unlike that of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 她比源氏公子年长四岁，略感迟暮，难于为情；

en.t: She was four years older than Prince Genji, and feeling somewhat past her prime, she found the situation hard to bear;

units.source_text: 然而正当花信年华，容颜自是齐整艳丽。

en.t: yet she was still in the full bloom of youth, and her features were naturally refined and beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，不免反省：“此人实在毫无缺陷，

en.t: Seeing her, Prince Genji could not help reflecting, "This woman truly has no flaw at all;

units.source_text: 只因我心过分浮薄不端，致使她如此怨恨。”

en.t: it is only because my own heart is far too frivolous and faithless that I have made her resent me so deeply."

units.source_text: 她的父亲左大臣在诸大臣中，御眷特别深重。

en.t: Her father, the Minister of the Left, enjoyed especially deep imperial favor among all the ministers.

units.source_text: 她的母亲是皇上的胞妹，对此惟一掌上明珠，

en.t: Her mother was the emperor's own sister, and this only precious daughter, cherished like a jewel in the palm,

units.source_text: 悉心教养，无微不至。

en.t: had been raised with the utmost care and attention to every detail.

units.source_text: 葵姬自然高傲成性，自命不凡，

en.t: Lady Aoi had naturally grown proud by temperament and thought herself far above ordinary people,

units.source_text: 别人对她略有疏慢，便视为怪事。

en.t: so if anyone treated her with even slight neglect, she regarded it as something outrageous.

units.source_text: 但在源氏公子这个天之骄子看来，不足稀罕，

en.t: But to Prince Genji, favored by heaven as he was, none of this seemed especially remarkable,

units.source_text: 无可骄矜，一向视为寻常。

en.t: nor anything to take pride in, and he had always regarded it as ordinary.

units.source_text: 因此夫妇之间，隔阂自生。

en.t: Thus a distance naturally arose between husband and wife.

units.source_text: 左大臣对于公子的浮薄行径，亦感不满。

en.t: The Minister of the Left, too, felt dissatisfied with the prince's frivolous conduct.

units.source_text: 但见面之后，怨恨顿消，依旧热心款待。

en.t: But once they met face to face, his resentment vanished at once, and he entertained him warmly as before.
